title.zh: 當專案進度嚴重落後，你如何向相關利益者（Stakeholders）說明並解決？
title.en: When a project is severely delayed, how do you communicate with stakeholders and resolve it?

intent.zh: 考驗危機處理、誠實度以及是否具備主動溝通的擔當。
intent.en: Tests crisis management, honesty, and proactive communication.

safe_landing_script.zh: 這是一個很有挑戰性的問題。請給我 10 秒鐘整理思維，我想從『損害控管』與『替代方案』兩個方向來回應...
safe_landing_script.en: That is a great question. Please give me 10 seconds to organize my thoughts on damage control and contingency plans...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「我預期你會遇到困難，但我最擔心你隱瞞不報、直到問題不可收拾才說明。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "I expect challenges, but I fear you hiding them until it's too late."

focus.zh: 及時通報與執行指令

script.zh: 我會先盤點受影響的工作並整理成清單，第一時間向主管匯報，並提供加班或調整優先順序的選項供主管決策。
script.en: I will audit affected tasks, prepare a summary, report to my manager immediately, and offer options such as prioritizing tasks.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「我不想只聽你報告壞消息，我要聽你的補救方案與所需的資源。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Don't just bring me bad news; bring me mitigation plans and resource requirements."

focus.zh: 資源調配與範疇取捨 (Trade-offs)

script.zh: 我會評估延誤的瓶頸，向 Stakeholders 提出兩個方案：一是削減 20% 非核心功能以按時交付；二是增加資源延後一週，並分析利弊。
script.en: I will evaluate the bottlenecks and offer stakeholders two options: reduce 20% non-core scope for on-time delivery, or add resources to defer by a week.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「你能不能站在公司商業利益的角度止血？事後如何建立體制防止再發生？」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Can you mitigate risks from a business ROI perspective and prevent recurrence?"

focus.zh: 商業風險控管與制度復盤

script.zh: 我會親自與高層對齊商業影響，重新排定優先順序以保住核心商業價值；同時啟動備用資源止血，並在事後進行復盤與更新 SOP。
script.en: I will align with senior stakeholders to protect core business value, deploy contingency resources, and conduct a post-mortem to update SOPs.

title.zh: 當你與同事/上司對專案方向有嚴重分歧，你會如何處理？
title.en: When you have a major disagreement with a teammate or manager on project direction, how do you handle it?

intent.zh: 考驗 EQ、溝通技巧，以及是否以公司利益為重（對事不對人）。
intent.en: Tests EQ, communication skills, and whether you prioritize company goals over personal ego.

safe_landing_script.zh: 處理分歧最重要的是『對事不對人』。請給我幾秒鐘整理我解決衝突的三個步驟...
safe_landing_script.en: Handling disagreement is about focusing on goals, not egos. Allow me a few seconds to organize my 3-step approach...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「我想看你是一味頂撞，還是懂得傾聽與服從決策。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "I want to see if you argue stubbornly or listen and follow decisions smoothly."

focus.zh: 積極聆聽與尋求共識

script.zh: 我會先私下了解對方背後的考量並以客觀數據討論。若最終無法達成共識，我會尊重主管的最終決定並全力配合執行。
script.en: I will seek to understand their rationale privately and discuss using objective data. If unresolved, I respect and execute the manager's final decision.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「展現你的影響力，試著在不依賴上司介入的情況下，透過協商達成共識。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Show your influence. Try to reach a consensus through negotiation without relying on your manager's intervention."

focus.zh: 尋求雙贏與方案協商

script.zh: 我會發起討論，重點擺在『如何共同達成專案目標』，並主動尋求方案折衷點，確保最終決策能兼顧雙方核心關切。
script.en: I will initiate a discussion focusing on achieving project goals together, actively seeking compromise points to address key concerns of both sides.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「你如何平衡專案品質與團隊關係？是否懂得用數據說服人？」
hiring_manager_os.en: "How do you balance project quality and team relationships? Can you persuade using data?"

focus.zh: 數據驅動與小規模測試 (A/B Testing)

script.zh: 我會將爭議轉化為可量化的假設，建議進行小規模測試，用真實數據說服 Stakeholders，避免無謂的主觀爭辯。
script.en: I turn arguments into quantifiable hypotheses and propose small-scale pilot tests to rely on real data rather than subjective opinions.

title.zh: 請分享一次你做錯決定，導致專案失敗或損失的經歷。
title.en: Tell me about a time you made a wrong decision that led to project failure or loss.

intent.zh: 考驗抗壓性、責任感，以及是否有『復盤 (Post-mortem)』與持續改善的能力。
intent.en: Tests resilience, accountability, and the habit of post-mortem reflection.

safe_landing_script.zh: 犯錯是學習的過程。請給我十秒鐘，我分享一個我早期從中獲得極大成長的經驗...
safe_landing_script.en: Mistakes are learning opportunities. Give me ten seconds to share an early experience that taught me a valuable lesson...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「我不怕你犯錯，我最怕你推卸責任。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "I don't mind mistakes; I mind blaming others."

focus.zh: 勇於承擔與即時補救

script.zh: 我曾低估任務複雜度導致延誤。當時我第一時間承認錯誤，連夜與團隊制定補救方案，確保交付品質。
script.en: I once underestimated task complexity causing delay. I immediately owned the error and worked with the team on a quick workaround.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「承認錯誤之餘，我更在乎你如何從中總結經驗，並調整後續的執行流程。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Beyond admitting mistakes, I care about how you summarize learnings and adjust execution workflows."

focus.zh: 經驗總結與流程調整

script.zh: 那次失誤讓我意識到風險評估不足。事後我重新檢視工作流程，並在未來的專案中預留額外的緩衝時間與檢核點。
script.en: That mistake made me realize the gap in my risk assessment. Afterwards, I reviewed my workflow and introduced buffer time and checkpoints for future projects.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「你有沒有將這個教訓轉化為制度，避免公司再犯？」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Did you turn that lesson into a system to prevent future failures company-wide?"

focus.zh: 系統性復盤與組織進化

script.zh: 事後我帶領團隊進行深度復盤，並建立了審查 Checklist 制度。自此之後，團隊未再發生同類錯誤。
script.en: I led a post-mortem and instituted a review checklist system. Since then, the team has had zero recurring errors of this type.

title.zh: 【筆試】客戶提出不合理的預算與交期要求，請寫一封拒絕信並維護良好關係。
title.en: [Written Test] A client demands an unrealistic budget and deadline. Write a refusal email while maintaining a good relationship.

intent.zh: 考驗專業底線、談判技巧，以及商業書信的條理性與 EQ。
intent.en: Tests professional boundaries, negotiation skills, EQ, and structured writing.

safe_landing_script.zh: 寫這類信的核心是：『先感謝、後說明客觀限制、最後給予 Option A 與 B 選擇』...
safe_landing_script.en: The key structure for this email is: Acknowledge -> Explain Objective Constraints -> Provide Options A & B...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「看你語氣是否太生硬，或是盲目答應公司做不到的事。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Let's see if your tone is overly blunt or if you blindly agree to impossible terms."

focus.zh: 禮貌拒絕與清晰說明理由

script.zh: 感謝您的查詢。為確保專案品質與資安標準，我們無法在現有預算與時間內完成。若有調整空間，我們非常樂意進一步討論。
script.en: Thank you for reaching out. To ensure quality and security standards, we cannot meet the request under current constraints, but welcome further discussion if parameters adjust.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「你需要在維持公司利潤的前提下，展現合作誠意並引導對方調整期望。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Show willingness to cooperate while safeguarding company margins by guiding their expectations."

focus.zh: 維護底線與引導期望

script.zh: 感謝您的提議。基於目前的市場成本與品質要求，該預算確實無法涵蓋完整範疇。我們建議調整階段目標，優先交付核心模組以符合您的時間表。
script.en: Thank you for the proposal. Based on current cost and quality requirements, the budget cannot cover the full scope. We suggest adjusting milestones to deliver core modules first.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「高階人員不會只說不行，而是會給予商業上可行的替代方案。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Seniors don't just say no; they offer viable strategic alternatives."

focus.zh: 商業談判與替代方案 (Trade-offs)

script.zh: 感謝您的信任。為確保交付品質，我們提供兩個替代方案：方案 A 為按時交付但調整範疇；方案 B 為維持完整範疇但調整時間。建議本週開會對齊優先順序。
script.en: Thank you for your trust. To safeguard quality, we offer two options: Option A (on-time delivery with scaled-back scope) or Option B (full scope with adjusted timeline). Let's schedule a brief call to align.

title.zh: 你平時如何保持自己在所屬領域的專業技能與知識與時俱進？
title.en: How do you keep your professional skills and industry knowledge up to date?

intent.zh: 考驗主動學習能力、對行業的熱情，以及是否具備自主進化（Self-driven）的習慣。
intent.en: Tests self-driven learning habits, passion for the industry, and adaptability.

safe_landing_script.zh: 分享學習習慣時，重點是『輸入 (Input)』加『輸出 (Output/實踐)』...
safe_landing_script.en: When sharing learning habits, focus on both Information Input and Practical Output...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「我想知道你下班後會不會主動學習，還是需要人鞭策。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "I want to know if you learn proactively or only when pushed."

focus.zh: 多元學習管道與習慣

script.zh: 我習慣訂閱業界權威電子報與 Podcast，每週花 3-5 小時研讀最新案例，並將技巧應用於日常工作中。
script.en: I subscribe to industry newsletters and podcasts, spending 3-5 hours weekly studying cases and applying learnings to my daily work.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「除了自我學習，我希望能看到你將新知識轉化為改善實際工作效率的行動。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Beyond self-learning, I want to see you translate knowledge into actions that boost efficiency."

focus.zh: 知識轉化與效率提升

script.zh: 我會持續追蹤新工具與產業趨勢，並在評估可行性後引進至個人或小組的工作流程中，以實際提升專案的交付品質。
script.en: I track new tools and industry trends, evaluating feasibility before introducing them into team workflows to tangibly improve delivery quality.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「高階人員不只自己學，還會將知識帶入團隊，建立影響力。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Seniors don't just learn individually; they share knowledge to elevate the team and industry."

focus.zh: 知識共享與團隊賦能

script.zh: 除了個人吸收趨勢，我每月會舉辦團隊內部知識分享會，並撰寫實戰文章，透過『以教為學』帶動團隊升級。
script.en: Besides personal research, I host monthly internal knowledge-sharing sessions and write articles to elevate team capability through teaching.

title.zh: 當上司或客戶給出的需求非常模糊時，你會如何處理？
title.en: When a manager or client provides very ambiguous requirements, how do you handle it?

intent.zh: 考驗需求釐清能力、主動溝通技巧及避免重做成本的商業意識。
intent.en: Tests the ability to clarify requirements, proactive communication, and awareness of avoiding rework costs.

safe_landing_script.zh: 應對模糊需求的核心是『先收窄範圍』。請容許我用十秒鐘整理一下我的釐清步驟...
safe_landing_script.en: The core of handling ambiguous requests is to 'narrow the scope first'. Please allow me 10 seconds to organize my clarification steps...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「我希望看到你不會憑空猜測，而是懂得提出具體問題來確認細節。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "I want to see that you don't just guess blindly, but ask specific questions to confirm details."

focus.zh: 主動發問與確認指令

script.zh: 我會先根據自己的理解，列出 3 至 5 個具體的確認問題，並以電郵或簡短會議向上司/客戶逐一釐清，確保雙方期望一致後才開始動工。
script.en: I will list 3 to 5 specific questions based on my understanding, and clarify them with the manager/client via email or a quick sync to ensure alignment before starting work.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「我不需要你只帶著問題來找我，我需要你帶著初步方案（Options）來讓我做選擇。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Don't just bring me questions; bring me preliminary options to choose from."

focus.zh: 提供原型與引導式選擇

script.zh: 我會利用過往經驗，快速草擬兩個不同方向的初步方案（Option A 與 Option B），並帶著這些草案與對方討論。讓他們在具體框架下做出選擇，能更有效收窄模糊地帶。
script.en: I will draft two preliminary directions (Option A and B) based on past experience and present them for discussion. Letting them choose within a concrete framework effectively narrows the ambiguity.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「客戶有時連自己想要什麼都不知道。你具備挖掘背後真實商業痛點的能力嗎？」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Sometimes clients don't know what they want. Can you uncover their underlying business pain points?"

focus.zh: 挖掘商業目的與重新定義需求

script.zh: 我會暫時放下表面需求，轉而詢問他們『最終想解決什麼商業問題』或『核心 KPI 是什麼』。當釐清了底層的商業目的後，我會以專業角度為他們重新定義並規劃最合適的解決方案。
script.en: I will look past the surface request and ask what ultimate business problem they aim to solve or what the core KPI is. Once the underlying business goal is clear, I will professionally redefine and architect the most suitable solution for them.

title.zh: 手上有三個高優先級任務，但時間只夠完成一個，你會如何抉擇？
title.en: You have three high-priority tasks but only time to complete one. How do you choose?

intent.zh: 考驗時間管理、資源調配及與利益相關者談判的能力。
intent.en: Tests time management, resource allocation, and negotiation skills with stakeholders.

safe_landing_script.zh: 處理資源衝突的核心是『透明度』與『影響力評估』。請給我幾秒鐘梳理一下我的判斷標準...
safe_landing_script.en: Handling resource conflicts requires transparency and impact assessment. Give me a few seconds to organize my evaluation criteria...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「遇到超載情況，懂得及時舉手求助，遠勝於默默超時工作最後卻未能達標。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "When overloaded, raising a flag for help is far better than working silently and failing to deliver."

focus.zh: 及時匯報與尋求指示

script.zh: 我會立刻整理這三個任務的現狀，並向主管如實匯報時間上的瓶頸，請求主管根據部門的最新目標，指示哪一個任務需要優先執行。
script.en: I will summarize the status of all three tasks, transparently report the time constraints to my manager, and ask for their direction on which task to prioritize based on the department's latest goals.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「我期望你能獨立評估急迫性與重要性，並提出有邏輯的排序建議。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "I expect you to independently assess urgency vs. importance and provide a logical recommendation."

focus.zh: 影響力評估與協商

script.zh: 我會運用艾森豪矩陣（Eisenhower Matrix）分析這三個任務對業務的實際影響與依賴關係。我會主動向 Stakeholders 建議優先完成價值最高的一個，並為另外兩個任務協商新的交付期。
script.en: I will use the Eisenhower Matrix to analyze the actual business impact and dependencies of these tasks. I will proactively propose to stakeholders that we prioritize the most valuable one, and negotiate new deadlines for the other two.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「高階管理者需要解決『資源短缺』的根本問題，而不是只做任務排序。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Senior leaders must solve the root cause of resource shortage, not just prioritize tasks."

focus.zh: 跨部門資源調度與戰略對齊

script.zh: 我會將這三個任務與公司的季度戰略（OKRs）進行對齊，確定最核心的任務親自跟進。同時，我會迅速調動跨部門資源或外包團隊接手其餘工作，確保整體商業價值不受影響。
script.en: I will align the tasks with the company's quarterly OKRs and personally oversee the most critical one. Simultaneously, I will rapidly mobilize cross-functional resources or outsourced teams to handle the rest, ensuring no loss in overall business value.

title.zh: 團隊中有一位同事表現持續未達標，影響了專案進度，你會如何處理？
title.en: A team member is consistently underperforming, affecting project progress. How do you handle it?

intent.zh: 考驗團隊協作、同理心及困難對話（Difficult Conversations）的處理技巧。
intent.en: Tests teamwork, empathy, and the ability to navigate difficult conversations.

safe_landing_script.zh: 處理人事問題的核心是『先理解，後協助』。請給我十秒鐘梳理溝通的層次...
safe_landing_script.en: The core of handling personnel issues is 'understand first, assist later'. Give me 10 seconds to structure the communication layers...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「守好本分最重要。不要越權干涉，但也不要任由專案被拖垮。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Do your part first. Don't overstep, but don't let the project sink either."

focus.zh: 自我管理與適當上報

script.zh: 我會先確保自己的部分如期完成，並在日常協作中友善地詢問他是否遇到困難。如果情況持續影響整體進度，我會在不帶個人情緒的前提下，將客觀進度向主管反映。
script.en: I will ensure my own tasks are completed on time and politely ask if they are facing any blockers. If the situation persists and affects the overall progress, I will objectively report the status to my manager without personal bias.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「展現你的非職權領導力（Lateral Leadership），主動協助隊友渡過難關。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Show your lateral leadership by proactively helping a teammate overcome hurdles."

focus.zh: 同理心溝通與實質協助

script.zh: 我會私下約他喝杯咖啡，了解他是遇到了技術瓶頸還是個人問題。如果是技術困難，我會主動與他進行結對工作（Pairing）或分享相關資源，協助他重回正軌。
script.en: I would invite them for a private coffee chat to understand if they are facing technical bottlenecks or personal issues. If it's technical, I will proactively pair with them or share resources to help them get back on track.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「你需要具備教練（Coach）思維，找出根本原因並建立長效的績效改善機制。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "You need a coaching mindset to identify the root cause and establish long-term performance improvement mechanisms."

focus.zh: 根本原因分析與績效輔導

script.zh: 我會將問題拆解為『能力（Skill）』或『意願（Will）』的缺失。若是能力問題，我會為他安排培訓與明確的短期目標；若是意願問題，我會釐清其職業期望，必要時與 HR 介入制定績效改善計畫（PIP）。
script.en: I will diagnose whether it is a gap in 'Skill' or 'Will'. If it's skill, I will arrange training and set clear short-term goals. If it's will, I will clarify their career expectations and, if necessary, involve HR to initiate a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP).

title.zh: 【筆試】客戶因系統故障導致資料遺失而大發雷霆，請撰寫一封官方致歉與跟進電郵。
title.en: [Written Test] A client is furious due to data loss from a system failure. Write an official apology and follow-up email.

intent.zh: 考驗危機公關處理、文字安撫技巧、承擔責任的態度及解決問題的專業度。
intent.en: Tests crisis PR handling, empathetic writing, accountability, and professional problem-solving skills.

safe_landing_script.zh: 危機電郵的黃金框架是：承認事實 -> 說明現狀 -> 承諾補救時間表。請容許我整理一下措辭...
safe_landing_script.en: The golden framework for crisis emails is: Acknowledge facts -> Explain current status -> Commit to a timeline. Allow me to refine the phrasing...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「語氣必須誠懇，不要找藉口或推卸責任給第三方。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "The tone must be sincere. Do not make excuses or blame third parties."

focus.zh: 誠懇致歉與資訊通報

script.zh: 致 [客戶名稱]：對於本次系統故障造成的資料遺失，我們深表歉意。我們非常理解這對您的業務造成的困擾。目前已將情況列為最高緊急級別，技術團隊正在全力搶修，我們將盡快為您更新進度。
script.en: Dear [Client], We sincerely apologize for the data loss caused by the system failure. We deeply understand the disruption this has caused. We have escalated this to the highest priority, and our technical team is actively working on it. We will update you shortly.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「客戶生氣是因為缺乏安全感，你需要提供明確的排查進度與時間表。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Clients are angry because they lack security. You need to provide a clear investigation status and timeline."

focus.zh: 提供具體時間表與排查方向

script.zh: 致 [客戶名稱]：我們對此次故障致上最深的歉意。技術團隊目前已鎖定伺服器節點問題，正在進行備份資料復原測試。我們承諾將於今天下午 2:00 前為您提供詳細的診斷報告及預計修復時間，感謝您的耐心。
script.en: Dear [Client], Please accept our deepest apologies. Our tech team has isolated the server node issue and is testing backup data restoration. We commit to providing a detailed diagnostic report and estimated resolution time by 2:00 PM today. Thank you for your patience.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「除了修復眼前的問題，高階主管必須能重建客戶信任，將危機轉化為展現專業的契機。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Besides fixing the immediate issue, a senior leader must rebuild trust, turning a crisis into an opportunity to show professionalism."

focus.zh: 全面補救方案與長期預防機制

script.zh: 致 [客戶名稱]：對於此次嚴重故障，我代表公司向您鄭重致歉。我們已啟動災難復原程序，預計可於 4 小時內恢復 95% 的資料。為彌補您的損失，我們將豁免本月服務費。事後我將親自向您提交完整的事故復盤報告（RCA），並承諾引入多重異地備份機制，確保此類事件絕不重演。
script.en: Dear [Client], On behalf of the company, I sincerely apologize for this severe outage. We have initiated disaster recovery and expect to restore 95% of data within 4 hours. To compensate for the disruption, we will waive this month's fee. Afterwards, I will personally present a comprehensive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implement multi-region backup mechanisms to guarantee this never happens again.

title.zh: 如果你發現一個新技術或流程可以大幅提升效率，你會如何說服管理層採用？
title.en: If you discover a new tech or process that greatly improves efficiency, how do you convince management to adopt it?

intent.zh: 考驗變革管理（Change Management）、商業簡報技巧及向上管理的影響力。
intent.en: Tests change management, business presentation skills, and the impact of upward management.

safe_landing_script.zh: 說服管理層的核心不在於技術有多炫，而在於能『節省多少成本』或『增加多少利潤』。請給我幾秒鐘整理我的商業提案...
safe_landing_script.en: Convincing management is not about how cool the tech is, but how much cost it saves or profit it generates. Let me organize my business pitch...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「有熱忱是好事，但在提議前，請確保你已經做足了功課，而不是只丟出一個點子。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Enthusiasm is good, but make sure you've done your homework before proposing, rather than just throwing out an idea."

focus.zh: 資料蒐集與可行性分析

script.zh: 我會先進行資料搜集，整理出新技術的優缺點對比、業界成功案例以及所需的學習資源。然後，我會準備一份簡短的總結報告，向主管請教是否值得在團隊內進一步探討。
script.en: I will conduct research to compile a pros/cons comparison, industry success cases, and required learning resources. Then, I will prepare a brief summary report and ask my manager if it's worth exploring further within the team.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「數據勝於雄辯（Data speaks louder than words）。用實際結果來說服我。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Data speaks louder than words. Persuade me with actual results."

focus.zh: 概念驗證 (PoC) 與數據展示

script.zh: 我會在不影響日常工作的前提下，利用業餘時間製作一個小規模的概念驗證（PoC）。當我能用具體數據證明新流程可以節省團隊 20% 的工時後，我會帶著這份實測數據向管理層進行簡報。
script.en: Without affecting daily tasks, I will build a small-scale Proof of Concept (PoC). Once I can prove with concrete data that the new process saves 20% of team hours, I will present these empirical findings to management.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「除了技術可行性，高階管理者必須能回答：導入成本多少？過渡期的風險如何轉移？」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Beyond technical feasibility, a senior leader must answer: What is the adoption cost, and how do we mitigate transition risks?"

focus.zh: 投資回報率 (ROI) 與全面導入戰略

script.zh: 我會提交一份完整的商業提案，內容包含預期的投資回報率（ROI）、導入成本估算，以及風險緩解計畫。我會建議分階段導入（Phased Roll-out），並設立先導小組（Pilot Team），確保變革過程平穩且帶來實質的商業增長。
script.en: I will submit a complete business proposal including projected ROI, adoption cost estimates, and risk mitigation plans. I would recommend a phased roll-out with a pilot team to ensure the transition is smooth and delivers tangible business growth.

title.zh: 專案即將上線，但高層突然要求加入全新功能，你會如何應對？
title.en: The project is about to launch, but senior management suddenly requests a new feature. How do you respond?

intent.zh: 評估變更管理（Change Management）、影響力分析與向上談判能力。
intent.en: Evaluates change management, impact analysis, and upward negotiation skills.

safe_landing_script.zh: 面對突發需求，最忌立刻拒絕或盲目答應。請容許我用十秒鐘整理我的評估框架...
safe_landing_script.en: When facing sudden requests, avoid immediate rejection or blind acceptance. Allow me 10 seconds to structure my assessment framework...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「我不想看到你驚慌失措，請確保你能清晰傳達這個變更對你目前工作的具體影響。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Don't panic. Make sure you can clearly communicate how this change impacts your current workload."

focus.zh: 通報影響與確認優先順序

script.zh: 我會先記錄新功能的具體需求，並向主管匯報這將如何影響我手上的現有任務。我會請示主管，是否需要暫停原定工作來優先處理這項新要求。
script.en: I will note the specific requirements of the new feature and report to my manager how it affects my current tasks. I will ask if I should pause existing work to prioritize this request.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「你需要扮演守門員（Gatekeeper），用數據告訴高層『代價是什麼』，並提供折衷方案。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Act as a gatekeeper. Use data to show management the 'cost' and provide compromise solutions."

focus.zh: 影響評估與階段性發佈 (Phased Release)

script.zh: 我會快速評估新功能對時程與資源的影響。如果會嚴重延誤上線，我會建議採用『階段性發佈』：先按原定計畫推出核心版本，並將新功能列入下一次迭代（Phase 2），以平衡商業需求與專案穩定性。
script.en: I will quickly assess the impact on the timeline and resources. If it causes severe delays, I will propose a 'phased release': launching the core version as planned and including the new feature in Phase 2 to balance business needs and stability.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「高階主管必須釐清這項變更背後的『商業戰略動機』，確保資源投入能帶來最大投資回報。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "A senior leader must clarify the 'strategic business motive' behind the change to ensure maximum ROI."

focus.zh: 商業價值對齊與資源重組

script.zh: 我會直接與高層對齊：這個新功能是為了解決什麼緊急的商業痛點？如果其 ROI 確實高於如期上線的價值，我會重新調配跨部門資源並重新設定市場預期；否則，我會以數據說服高層維持原判。
script.en: I will align directly with senior management: What urgent business pain point does this solve? If its ROI genuinely outweighs an on-time launch, I will reallocate cross-functional resources and reset market expectations. Otherwise, I will use data to persuade them to stay the course.

title.zh: 你的專案依賴另一個部門的資源，但對方的 KPI 與你的目標有衝突，你會如何推進？
title.en: Your project relies on another department, but their KPIs conflict with yours. How do you proceed?

intent.zh: 考驗橫向領導力（Lateral Leadership）、利益對齊與雙贏談判技巧。
intent.en: Tests lateral leadership, goal alignment, and win-win negotiation skills.

safe_landing_script.zh: 解決部門衝突的關鍵在於『尋找共同利益』。請給我幾秒鐘思考如何設計一個雙贏方案...
safe_landing_script.en: The key to resolving departmental conflicts is finding mutual interests. Give me a few seconds to think about a win-win scenario...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「不要與其他部門起衝突，遇到無法解決的僵局應及時上報。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Don't create friction with other departments. Escalate appropriately when hitting a deadlock."

focus.zh: 釐清衝突點與適當上報

script.zh: 我會先與對方部門的窗口溝通，了解他們目前的任務優先級與痛點。如果確認雙方目標確實存在不可調和的衝突，我會整理具體情況向我的主管匯報，請求更高級別的協調。
script.en: I will communicate with the other department's point of contact to understand their priorities and pain points. If there is an irreconcilable conflict, I will summarize the situation and report to my manager to seek higher-level coordination.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「展現你的影響力，試著在不依賴上司介入的情況下，透過協商達成共識。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Show your influence. Try to reach a consensus through negotiation without relying on your manager's intervention."

focus.zh: 尋找共同利益與資源交換

script.zh: 我會主動發起會議，不談『我的需求』，而是探討『這個專案能如何幫助他們達成 KPI』。如果需要，我會提議資源交換，或者在專案設計上做出讓步，確保方案對雙方都有利。
script.en: I will initiate a meeting, focusing not on 'my needs' but on 'how this project can help achieve their KPIs'. If necessary, I will propose a resource exchange or make concessions in the project design to ensure a mutually beneficial outcome.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「系統性的 KPI 衝突需要由上而下解決，你能否推動戰略層面的重新對齊？」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Systemic KPI conflicts require top-down resolution. Can you drive strategic realignment?"

focus.zh: 戰略對齊與推動高層決策

script.zh: 這種衝突通常源於公司戰略未完全對齊。我會將此視為一個系統性問題，整理一份商業影響分析，拉攏雙方部門主管進行對話，推動高層重新審視並調整激勵機制，確保全公司的努力方向一致。
script.en: Such conflicts usually stem from misaligned company strategies. I will treat this as a systemic issue, prepare a business impact analysis, bring department heads together, and push executives to realign incentives to ensure company-wide cohesion.

title.zh: 【筆試】請撰寫一封電郵給日理萬機的高層，爭取一筆預算以升級現有系統。
title.en: [Written Test] Write an email to a busy executive requesting a budget to upgrade an existing system.

intent.zh: 考驗精準表達（Elevator Pitch）、投資回報率 (ROI) 分析及商業書信邏輯。
intent.en: Tests concise communication (Elevator Pitch), ROI analysis, and business writing logic.

safe_landing_script.zh: 寫給高層的電郵必須遵循『結論先行 (BLUF)』原則。請給我十秒鐘構思電郵結構...
safe_landing_script.en: Emails to executives must follow the BLUF (Bottom Line Up Front) principle. Give me 10 seconds to structure the email...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「郵件必須簡潔，清楚列出當前痛點以及升級後的好處。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "The email must be concise, clearly listing current pain points and the benefits of the upgrade."

focus.zh: 痛點描述與清晰訴求

script.zh:
主旨：關於升級現有客戶管理系統的預算申請

您好，由於現有系統經常當機，導致團隊每週浪費約 10 小時進行手動修復。為提升運營效率，我希望能申請一筆預算升級系統。附件為初步的方案細節，希望能與您進一步討論。謝謝。
script.en:
Subject: Budget Request for CRM System Upgrade

Hi [Name], The current system's frequent crashes cause the team to waste roughly 10 hours weekly on manual fixes. To improve efficiency, I am requesting a budget to upgrade the system. Details are attached. I look forward to discussing this further. Thank you.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「高層沒時間看長篇大論，你需要直接給出金額、預期效益與具體時間表。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Executives lack time for essays. Provide the amount, expected benefits, and timeline directly."

focus.zh: 結論先行與具體解決方案
focus.en: Bottom Line Up Front (BLUF) & Concrete Solutions

script.zh:
主旨：申請 $X 萬系統升級預算，預期提升 30% 處理效率

您好，為解決近期系統延遲導致的客訴問題，我提議撥款 $X 萬升級現有架構。此升級預計能在兩個月內完成，並為團隊節省 30% 的工時，成本將於半年內回本。詳情請見附件商業論證 (Business Case)，期待您的審批。
script.en:
Subject: Budget Request for $X Upgrade - Expected 30% Efficiency Gain

Hi [Name], To resolve recent customer complaints caused by system latency, I propose a $X budget to upgrade our architecture. The upgrade will take two months, save 30% in team hours, and pay for itself within six months. Please see the attached Business Case for approval.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「你需要將技術升級翻譯成『商業語言』：不升級的風險是什麼？投資回報率 (ROI) 是多少？」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Translate technical upgrades into business language: What is the risk of doing nothing? What is the ROI?"

focus.zh: 商業影響 (ROI) 與風險緩解

script.zh:
主旨：【需審批】系統升級預算申請 - 預計降低 15% 客戶流失率

您好，現有系統架構已無法支撐 Q3 的業務增長目標，若維持現狀，預估將面臨每月 $Y 萬的潛在營收流失風險。為此，我申請 $X 萬預算進行全面升級。該方案具備 150% 的首年 ROI，並已規劃零停機 (Zero Downtime) 轉移策略。附件為詳細的財務預測與風險緩解計畫，懇請審批。
script.en:
Subject: [Approval Required] System Upgrade Budget - Projected 15% Reduction in Churn

Hi [Name], Our current architecture cannot support Q3 growth targets. Inaction risks a potential monthly revenue loss of $Y. I am requesting $X to overhaul the system. This yields a 150% Year-1 ROI with a zero-downtime migration strategy. Attached are the financial projections and risk mitigation plans for your approval.

title.zh: 在產品發佈前夕，你發現了一個可能影響用戶體驗的缺陷，但延遲發佈會引發公關危機，你會如何決策？
title.en: Right before a launch, you discover a flaw affecting user experience, but delaying will cause a PR crisis. How do you decide?

intent.zh: 考驗在極端壓力下的決策邏輯、風險權衡 (Trade-offs) 與誠信。
intent.en: Tests decision-making logic under pressure, risk trade-offs, and integrity.

safe_landing_script.zh: 這是經典的『兩難困境』。請給我幾秒鐘，我會依據缺陷的嚴重程度來制定不同情境的應對策略...
safe_landing_script.en: This is a classic dilemma. Give me a few seconds to outline scenario-based strategies depending on the severity of the flaw...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「絕不能隱瞞。我需要你第一時間提供準確的資訊，讓管理層做決定。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Never cover it up. I need you to provide accurate information immediately so management can decide."

focus.zh: 即時通報與提供事實

script.zh: 我絕對不會隱瞞。我會立刻收集該缺陷觸發的條件與影響範圍，第一時間向專案經理與主管通報，並配合技術團隊測試修復方案，交由管理層定奪是否延遲發佈。
script.en: I will never hide it. I will immediately gather facts on trigger conditions and impact scope, escalate to the project manager, and assist the tech team in testing fixes so management can decide whether to delay.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「提出問題的同時，請準備好緊急的降級方案或熱修復 (Hotfix) 計畫。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "When raising the issue, have an emergency downgrade or hotfix plan ready."

focus.zh: 損害控管與應變方案

script.zh: 我會快速評估該缺陷是否屬於『致命層級』。如果是，我會強烈建議延遲發佈並啟動公關預案；若只是體驗瑕疵，我會建議如期發佈，但同時準備好上線後的熱修復 (Hotfix) 補丁，並在內部準備好客服應對指引。
script.en: I will assess if the flaw is 'critical'. If so, I strongly recommend delaying and triggering PR protocols. If it's a minor UX glitch, I suggest launching as planned but preparing a post-launch hotfix and briefing customer service with response guidelines.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「在商業聲譽與法律風險之間，你需要具備全盤的戰略眼光來調度各部門。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Between business reputation and legal risk, you need a holistic strategic vision to coordinate departments."

focus.zh: 全面危機管理與內外溝通戰略

script.zh: 這是一場商業風險評估。我會立即召集技術、公關與法務主管召開緊急會議。若缺陷涉及資安或合規，必須無條件延遲發佈，並親自主導對外的透明溝通以保護長期品牌聲譽；若僅是功能受限，我會採取『Beta 試運行』名義降級發佈，既守住承諾也管理好市場預期。
script.en: This is a business risk assessment. I will immediately convene Tech, PR, and Legal heads. If it's a security/compliance flaw, we delay unconditionally, and I will lead transparent external communication to protect long-term brand equity. If it's a functional limitation, I will launch it as a 'Beta' release, keeping our promise while managing market expectations.

title.zh: 團隊中有一位新入職的員工遲遲未能適應工作節奏，你會如何協助他？
title.en: A new hire is struggling to adapt to the work pace. How do you assist them?

intent.zh: 考驗同理心、輔導技巧 (Coaching) 及建立團隊知識庫的能力。
intent.en: Tests empathy, coaching skills, and the ability to build team knowledge bases.

safe_landing_script.zh: 協助新人的核心步驟是『診斷問題』與『給予明確目標』。請容許我用幾秒鐘梳理我的輔導流程...
safe_landing_script.en: The core of assisting new hires is diagnosing the problem and providing clear goals. Allow me a few seconds to outline my coaching process...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「展現你的團隊精神，主動伸出援手，但不要因此拖累自己的進度。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Show team spirit by reaching out, but don't let it derail your own progress."

focus.zh: 分享經驗與友善支援

script.zh: 我會主動關心他，分享我自己當初剛入職時的適應經驗與筆記，讓他感到被接納。同時，在不影響我自身工作的範圍內，針對他不熟悉的工具或流程提供快速解答。
script.en: I would proactively check in, share my own early onboarding experiences and notes to make him feel welcome. Within limits that don't affect my own work, I will provide quick answers regarding tools or processes he's unfamiliar with.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「你需要扮演導師 (Mentor) 的角色，提供結構化的指導與階段性反饋。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "You need to act as a mentor, providing structured guidance and milestone feedback."

focus.zh: 結構化輔導與結對工作

script.zh: 我會與他進行一對一交流，找出是『專業技能』還是『公司流程』的瓶頸。接著，我會為他拆解任務，設定較小的短期里程碑，並安排結對工作 (Pairing) 來及時糾正錯誤，幫助他建立自信。
script.en: I will have a 1-on-1 to identify if the bottleneck is 'technical skill' or 'company processes'. Then, I will break down tasks, set small short-term milestones, and arrange pair work to provide immediate correction and build their confidence.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「新人無法適應，往往是公司的入職流程 (Onboarding) 出了問題，你能否從根本解決？」
hiring_manager_os.en: "When new hires struggle, it's often a systemic onboarding flaw. Can you fix the root cause?"

focus.zh: 優化入職流程與團隊梯隊建設

script.zh: 除了親自輔導該名員工，我會退一步審視這是否暴露出我們部門 Onboarding 流程的缺陷。我會推動建立標準化的知識庫 (Wiki) 與『學長姐制度 (Buddy System)』，確保未來的每一位新人都能更平滑地融入團隊。
script.en: Beyond coaching the individual, I will step back to assess if this exposes a flaw in our department's onboarding process. I will push to establish a standardized Wiki and a Buddy System to ensure every future new hire integrates smoothly into the team.

title.zh: 一位非常有影響力的高層（或大客戶）要求你繞過標準流程「特事特辦」，這會帶來潛在合規風險，你會如何應對？
title.en: A highly influential executive (or VIP client) asks you to bypass standard procedures for a 'special favor', which carries compliance risks. How do you respond?

intent.zh: 考驗在極端壓力下的原則底線、合規意識（Compliance）以及圓滑的拒絕藝術。
intent.en: Tests integrity under pressure, compliance awareness, and the art of saying no diplomatically.

safe_landing_script.zh: 應對特權要求的核心是『把風險具象化』，而非直接說不。請給我幾秒鐘整理溝通策略...
safe_landing_script.en: The core of handling VIP requests is 'visualizing the risk' rather than a flat no. Give me a few seconds to structure my communication strategy...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「我希望你不會因為對方職級高就盲目違規，懂得尋求直屬主管的保護。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "I hope you don't break rules blindly just because of their rank. Know when to seek your manager's protection."

focus.zh: 堅守底線與適當上報

script.zh: 我會禮貌地向該高層說明現行流程是為了保護公司及專案的安全。如果對方堅持，我會表示需要先向直屬主管請示與備案，確保所有操作都在合規的授權下進行。
script.en: I would politely explain to the executive that the standard process exists to protect the company and the project. If they insist, I will state that I must seek approval and document it with my direct manager to ensure compliance.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「你需要有能力在不激怒對方的前提下，將『個人拒絕』轉化為『制度風險』。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "You need the ability to transform a 'personal refusal' into a 'systemic risk assessment' without angering them."

focus.zh: 風險轉移與提供合規捷徑

script.zh: 我會先肯定對方需求的急迫性，然後將焦點轉移到風險上：『如果不走標準流程，可能會引發後續的合規稽核問題』。同時，我會主動提供一個『在現有框架內最快的加急方案』，既幫他解決問題，又守住底線。
script.en: I will first acknowledge the urgency of their request, then shift the focus to the risk: 'Bypassing the process might trigger compliance audit issues later.' Simultaneously, I will offer the 'fastest expedited option within the existing framework' to solve their problem while maintaining boundaries.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「高階主管應該洞察到流程本身是否已經僵化，並從根本上解決『為什麼高層需要繞過流程』的問題。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Senior leaders should discern if the process itself is too rigid and solve the root cause of 'why executives feel the need to bypass it'."

focus.zh: 識別系統瓶頸與流程再造

script.zh: 當下我會與法務或合規部門緊急評估特例授權的可行性以解決眼前危機。但事後，我會將這視為一個『系統性警訊』——如果連高層都覺得流程太慢，代表我們的標準作業程序（SOP）已經成為商業瓶頸。我會牽頭發起流程優化專案，建立合規的『快速通道（Fast-track）』機制。
script.en: Immediately, I would urgently consult Legal/Compliance to assess the feasibility of an exceptional authorization. However, post-incident, I treat this as a 'systemic red flag'—if executives feel the process is too slow, our SOP is a business bottleneck. I would lead a process reengineering initiative to establish a compliant 'Fast-track' mechanism.

title.zh: 專案死線逼近，但你發現如果按時交付，產品品質將大打折扣（Technical Debt）。你會選擇延遲交付，還是先上線再說？
title.en: The project deadline is looming. You realize that delivering on time means sacrificing quality (creating Technical Debt). Do you delay the launch or ship it as is?

intent.zh: 考驗在壓力下的取捨（Trade-offs）能力、對「技術債」的認知及商業大局觀。
intent.en: Tests trade-off abilities under pressure, understanding of 'technical debt', and business acumen.

safe_landing_script.zh: 這不是非黑即白的選擇。請給我十秒鐘，我會根據『品質問題是否致命』來給出我的決策矩陣...
safe_landing_script.en: This is not a black-and-white choice. Give me 10 seconds to outline my decision matrix based on whether the quality issue is critical...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「我希望你不要自作主張。把品質的真實情況透明地告訴我，讓我來做商業決定。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Don't make this call alone. Transparently report the quality reality to me so I can make the business decision."

focus.zh: 透明化風險與尋求決策

script.zh: 我會立刻整理出目前產品已知的瑕疵清單，並標註哪些會影響核心功能、哪些只是外觀問題。我會將這份清單提交給主管與產品經理，讓團隊基於商業考量共同決定是否如期上線。
script.en: I will immediately compile a list of known defects, highlighting which impact core functionality and which are merely cosmetic. I will present this to my manager and the PM so the team can collectively decide whether to launch based on business considerations.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「你需要具備敏捷（Agile）思維，懂得將完美的產品降級為『最小可行性產品（MVP）』。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "You need an Agile mindset, knowing how to downgrade a perfect product into a Minimum Viable Product (MVP)."

focus.zh: MVP 思維與技術債管理

script.zh: 我會區分『核心價值』與『邊緣體驗』。如果瑕疵不影響核心業務運作（例如交易或資安），我建議按時上線以搶佔市場先機，並將修復工作列為上線後的首要 Sprint（技術債償還）。如果涉及致命錯誤，則堅決建議延期。
script.en: I differentiate between 'core value' and 'edge experience'. If the flaws don't impact critical operations (like transactions or security), I recommend launching on time to seize the market, while scheduling the fixes in the immediate post-launch Sprint (paying off technical debt). If it's a fatal flaw, I firmly recommend a delay.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「除了處理眼前的災難，我期望你能制定完整的上線後營運與補救戰略。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Beyond handling the immediate crisis, I expect you to formulate a complete post-launch operational and mitigation strategy."

focus.zh: 市場預期管理與營運緩解

script.zh: 這是『Time-to-Market』與『品質』的戰略博弈。若選擇如期上線，我會與營銷部門協調，將此次發佈定義為『Beta 測試版』以降低市場期望值；同時安排客服團隊就已知問題準備回應腳本，並指揮工程團隊進入 War Room 進行熱修復（Hotfix）。
script.en: This is a strategic trade-off between Time-to-Market and Quality. If we launch on time, I will coordinate with Marketing to position this as a 'Beta Release' to lower market expectations. Simultaneously, I will arm Customer Service with response scripts for known issues and direct the engineering team into a War Room for immediate hotfixes.

title.zh: 你經過詳盡的數據分析後，得出了一個結論，但你的上司卻基於他多年的「直覺」持相反意見。你會如何說服他？
title.en: After thorough data analysis, you reach a conclusion, but your manager disagrees based on their years of 'gut feeling'. How do you persuade them?

intent.zh: 考驗向上溝通的藝術、對數據盲點的反思能力以及影響力（Influence without Authority）。
intent.en: Tests the art of upward communication, ability to reflect on data blind spots, and influence without authority.

safe_landing_script.zh: 直覺往往是未被量化的經驗。請給我幾秒鐘，我會分享如何將數據與前輩的經驗結合...
safe_landing_script.en: Gut feeling is often unquantified experience. Give me a few seconds to share how I combine data with a veteran's experience...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「不要盲目相信數據，也不要盲目盲從。我希望你具備查證精神。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Don't blindly trust data, nor blindly submit. I want to see your investigative spirit."

focus.zh: 雙向驗證與虛心請教

script.zh: 我會先虛心請教上司直覺背後的考量，因為經驗往往包含數據未涵蓋的市場變數。接著，我會重新檢查自己的數據來源與分析模型是否存在盲點。如果確認數據無誤，我會將兩者並列，讓上司做最終決策。
script.en: I will humbly ask my manager about the rationale behind their gut feeling, as experience often captures market variables missing in the data. Next, I will double-check my data sources and models for blind spots. If the data is solid, I will present both side-by-side for them to make the final decision.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「用具象化的商業案例或小規模測試來證明你的觀點，而不是在會議桌上死爭。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Prove your point with concrete business cases or small-scale tests, rather than arguing stubbornly at the meeting table."

focus.zh: 提出假設與 A/B 測試

script.zh: 我不會直接否定上司的直覺。我會提議將雙方的觀點視為兩個『假設』，並建議在投入大量資源前，先進行為期兩週的 A/B 測試或小規模試點。讓市場的真實反饋來決定最終方向，這能有效化解對立。
script.en: I won't directly reject my manager's intuition. I will propose treating both viewpoints as 'hypotheses' and suggest running a two-week A/B test or a small pilot before committing major resources. Letting real market feedback decide the direction effectively diffuses the confrontation.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「高階管理者需要具備『將高層的直覺量化為數據指標』的能力。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Senior leaders must possess the ability to 'quantify executive intuition into data metrics'."

focus.zh: 量化直覺與建立決策框架

script.zh: 高層的直覺通常是高度壓縮的商業洞察。我會引導他將直覺拆解：『您擔憂的風險，是否能對應到我們漏看的某個用戶流失率或獲客成本指標？』透過將他的『經驗』轉化為新的『數據追蹤維度』，我們能建立一個更全面的決策模型，達成真正的共識。
script.en: Executive intuition is often highly compressed business insight. I will guide them to unpack it: 'Can the risk you're sensing be mapped to a churn rate or CAC metric we missed?' By translating their 'experience' into new 'data tracking dimensions', we build a more holistic decision model and reach a true consensus.

title.zh: 你被指派接手一個前人留下、完全沒有文檔（Documentation）或交接紀錄的專案。你會如何開展工作？
title.en: You are assigned to take over a legacy project with absolutely no documentation or handover notes from your predecessor. How do you start?

intent.zh: 考驗在高度模糊與混亂環境中的破局能力、系統思考以及韌性。
intent.en: Tests problem-solving skills in highly ambiguous environments, systems thinking, and resilience.

safe_landing_script.zh: 面對『黑盒』專案，最重要的是『從輸出推導輸入』。請給我幾秒鐘，我會分享我的拆解步驟...
safe_landing_script.en: When facing a 'black box' project, the key is reverse-engineering from output to input. Give me a few seconds to share my breakdown steps...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「我不想聽到你抱怨前人。我希望看到你主動尋找資源、拼湊全貌的行動力。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "I don't want to hear complaints about the predecessor. I want to see your initiative in finding resources and piecing the puzzle together."

focus.zh: 盤點現狀與建立聯繫

script.zh: 我不會抱怨現狀。我會先盤點目前能拿到的所有權限與原始碼，接著主動拜訪曾參與過該專案的其他部門同事（如 QA、客服或 PM），透過訪談將零碎的資訊拼湊起來，並開始建立第一版基礎文檔。
script.en: I won't complain about the situation. I will first audit all accessible permissions and source code. Then, I will proactively interview colleagues from other departments (like QA, CS, or PM) who were tangentially involved, piecing together the fragmented info to draft the very first baseline documentation.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「除了問人，你需要具備『逆向工程（Reverse Engineering）』的能力，讓系統自己說話。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Besides asking people, you need 'Reverse Engineering' skills to let the system speak for itself."

focus.zh: 逆向工程與核心路徑梳理

script.zh: 我會採取『逆向工程』策略：從最終用戶能看到的核心功能出發，逐步往回推導資料流與架構。同時，我會在關鍵節點加上日誌監控（Logging），讓系統運作時自己暴露出邏輯。這能在不影響線上運作的前提下，安全地繪製出系統架構圖。
script.en: I adopt a 'reverse engineering' strategy: starting from the core user-facing features and tracing the data flow and architecture backwards. Simultaneously, I will add logging to critical nodes, letting the running system reveal its own logic. This safely maps the architecture without disrupting live operations.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「接手爛攤子是建立新秩序的最佳時機。你應該藉此機會重新定義該專案的商業價值。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Taking over a mess is the best time to establish new order. You should use this opportunity to redefine the project's business value."

focus.zh: 價值重塑與技術防腐

script.zh: 接手無文檔專案是重新梳理商業邏輯的契機。我會先向 Stakeholders 確認該專案目前的『核心商業價值』是否依然成立。如果是，我會引入『防腐層（Anti-corruption Layer）』設計，將舊系統封裝，逐步用清晰的新架構進行微服務替換，徹底消除未來的技術風險。
script.en: Taking over an undocumented project is an opportunity to untangle business logic. I will first confirm with stakeholders if the project's 'core business value' still stands. If so, I will introduce an 'Anti-corruption Layer', encapsulating the legacy system and gradually migrating it to a clean, well-documented microservice architecture to permanently eliminate future technical risks.

title.zh: 你目前的工作量已經超載，但你的下屬經驗尚淺，你擔心交給他們會搞砸。你會如何處理？
title.en: You are currently overloaded with work, but your subordinates are inexperienced. You fear delegating to them will result in failure. How do you handle this?

intent.zh: 考驗領導者的授權智慧、風險控管以及培養團隊（Mentorship）的意願。
intent.en: Tests a leader's wisdom in delegation, risk control, and willingness to mentor the team.

safe_landing_script.zh: 不願授權是管理者的通病。請容許我分享我的『循序漸進授權法』...
safe_landing_script.en: Reluctance to delegate is a common managerial pitfall. Allow me to share my 'progressive delegation' approach...

hiring_manager_os.zh: （此題主要針對有管理潛力的候選人，Junior 職級較少遇到）
hiring_manager_os.en: (This question targets candidates with management potential; rarely asked at the Junior level.)

focus.zh: N/A

script.zh: 雖然我目前還沒有直接帶人的經驗，但如果我處於這個位置，我會先挑選容錯率較高的任務交給團隊，並在關鍵節點設定檢查機制，確保他們有機會學習又不至於影響大局。
script.en: Although I don't have direct management experience yet, if I were in this position, I would start by delegating tasks with a higher tolerance for error. I'd set up checkpoints at critical stages to ensure they learn without jeopardizing the big picture.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「如果你什麼都要自己做，你就永遠無法晉升。我需要看到你建立『容錯機制』的能力。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "If you do everything yourself, you can never be promoted. I need to see your ability to build 'error-tolerant mechanisms'."

focus.zh: 拆解任務與設立檢查點

script.zh: 『自己做比較快』是團隊成長的最大阻礙。我會將大型專案拆解為多個小模塊，將風險較低的部分授權給下屬。重點是我會設立明確的審查里程碑（Checkpoints），例如每天 15 分鐘的 Sync，確保能在錯誤擴大前及時糾正，讓他們在安全網內成長。
script.en: 'Doing it myself is faster' is the biggest blocker to team growth. I will break large projects into smaller modules and delegate lower-risk parts. Crucially, I will establish clear review checkpoints, like a 15-minute daily sync, to correct course before errors compound, allowing them to grow within a safety net.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「卓越的領導者不是創造追隨者，而是創造更多的領導者。你能否將犯錯轉化為團隊的 SOP？」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Great leaders don't create followers; they create more leaders. Can you turn their mistakes into team SOPs?"

focus.zh: 賦能與建立系統性知識庫

script.zh: 我必須接受『授權初期的效率下降』，這是培養梯隊的必經投資。我會採用『我做你看、我們一起做、你做我看』的教練模式。當下屬犯錯時，我不會責備，而是引導他們自行找出根本原因，並將解決方案寫入部門的 SOP，從根本上提升團隊的自動運作能力。
script.en: I must accept the 'initial efficiency dip of delegation' as a necessary investment in pipeline building. I use the 'I do you watch, we do together, you do I watch' coaching model. When they fail, I don't blame; I guide them to find the root cause and document the solution into our departmental SOPs, fundamentally elevating the team's autonomous capability.

title.zh: 請分享一次你收到嚴厲或負面反饋的經歷。你當時如何處理？
title.en: Tell me about a time you received harsh or negative feedback. How did you handle it?

intent.zh: 考驗防禦心理（Defensiveness）、自我反省能力，以及是否能將批評轉化為成長動力。
intent.en: Tests defensiveness, self-reflection, and the ability to turn criticism into growth.

safe_landing_script.zh: 面對負面反饋，核心是『將情緒與事實剝離』。請給我十秒鐘，我會分享一個讓我獲益良多的反饋經驗...
safe_landing_script.en: The key to handling negative feedback is separating emotion from facts. Give me 10 seconds to share a piece of feedback that truly helped me grow...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「我想知道你被批評時會不會馬上找藉口反駁，或是情緒崩潰。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "I want to see if you immediately make excuses or break down emotionally when criticized."

focus.zh: 傾聽與虛心接受

script.zh: 起初聽到負面反饋難免會感到挫折，但我會深呼吸，先不作辯解。我會仔細聆聽並記錄主管指出的具體缺失，然後在會後制定一份改進清單，並在接下來的幾週主動回報改善進度。
script.en: It's naturally frustrating at first, but I take a deep breath and avoid defending myself. I actively listen, take notes on the specific shortcomings, create an improvement checklist, and proactively report my progress in the following weeks.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「成熟的職場人不僅能接受批評，還能主動挖掘批評背後的盲點並優化工作流程。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "A mature professional doesn't just accept criticism; they uncover the blind spots behind it to optimize workflows."

focus.zh: 情緒抽離與流程優化

script.zh: 我會將『情緒』與『事實』剝離，把反饋視為一份免費的顧問報告。我曾被批評專案溝通不到位，事後我沒有糾結於對錯，而是主動設計了一套每週進度更新模板（Weekly Update Template），徹底解決了資訊落差的問題。
script.en: I separate 'emotion' from 'facts', treating the feedback as a free consulting report. When criticized for poor project communication, I didn't dwell on who was right. Instead, I proactively designed a Weekly Update Template that completely resolved the information gap.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「高階領導者需要展現『脆弱性（Vulnerability）』，以身作則建立團隊的安全感與回饋文化。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Senior leaders must show 'vulnerability' to role-model psychological safety and a feedback culture."

focus.zh: 擁抱脆弱與塑造文化

script.zh: 到了管理層，我會主動尋求 360 度反饋。當我收到嚴厲的批評時，我會在團隊會議上公開承認我的盲點，並分享我的改進計畫。這不僅展現了領導者的擔當，更能為團隊建立一個『允許犯錯、勇於指正』的心理安全文化。
script.en: As a leader, I actively seek 360-degree feedback. When I receive harsh criticism, I publicly acknowledge my blind spots in team meetings and share my improvement plan. This not only shows accountability but builds a culture of psychological safety where team members feel safe to make mistakes and correct each other.

title.zh: 請描述一個你必須在幾乎沒有預算或資源的情況下，達成重大成果的專案。
title.en: Describe a project where you had to achieve significant results with almost no budget or resources.

intent.zh: 考驗抗壓性、創意解難能力（Resourcefulness）以及能否在限制中尋找突破口。
intent.en: Tests resilience, creative problem-solving (resourcefulness), and finding breakthroughs within constraints.

safe_landing_script.zh: 資源永遠是不夠的。請給我幾秒鐘，我會分享如何透過『借力打力』來解決預算問題...
safe_landing_script.en: Resources are never enough. Give me a few seconds to share how I leverage external assets to solve budget constraints...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「我不在乎專案有多大，我在乎的是你會不會因為沒錢就直接放棄，或者只會伸手要資源。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "I don't care how big the project was. I care if you give up when there's no money, or just constantly ask for resources."

focus.zh: 優先順序與善用免費工具

script.zh: 面對零預算，我會專注於『時間』與『創意』的投入。我會嚴格區分 Must-have 與 Nice-to-have 的功能，善用市場上的開源軟體與免費工具來搭建 MVP（最小可行性產品），用最原始的方式手動驗證核心需求。
script.en: Facing zero budget, I focus on investing 'time' and 'creativity'. I strictly separate Must-haves from Nice-to-haves, utilizing open-source software and free tools to build an MVP, manually validating core requirements in the leanest way possible.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「你需要展現『跨部門協商』的能力，懂得挖掘公司內部閒置資源。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "You need to show cross-functional negotiation skills, finding unutilized resources within the company."

focus.zh: 內部資源談判與利益交換

script.zh: 沒有預算時，我會尋求『內部資源置換』。我曾主動與其他部門談判，協助他們解決一個技術痛點，換取他們團隊設計師 20% 的工時支援我的專案。透過建立雙贏的內部聯盟，我們在零預算下順利完成了交付。
script.en: Without a budget, I seek 'internal resource exchanges'. I once negotiated with another department, offering to solve their technical pain point in exchange for 20% of their designer's time. By building a win-win internal alliance, we successfully delivered with zero budget.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「高層想看到你具備商業拓展（BD）思維，能否拉攏外部合作夥伴共同承擔風險。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Executives want to see Business Development (BD) thinking—can you bring in external partners to share the risk?"

focus.zh: 外部戰略結盟與重塑 ROI

script.zh: 缺乏資源是一個商業模式問題。我會將視角轉向外部，尋找與我們擁有共同目標客群但非競爭關係的企業。透過發起『聯合行銷』或『戰略結盟』，雙方共享資源與數據，不僅解決了預算問題，更創造了 1+1 大於 2 的商業影響力。
script.en: A lack of resources is a business model problem. I shift my focus externally, looking for non-competing companies targeting the same audience. By initiating 'co-marketing' or 'strategic alliances', we share resources and data. This not only solves the budget issue but creates a synergy greater than the sum of its parts.

title.zh: 你如何應對突如其來的組織架構重組，或是公司戰略的全面轉變？
title.en: How do you handle sudden organizational restructuring or a complete shift in company strategy?

intent.zh: 考驗面對極端不確定性時的適應能力、情緒穩定度以及引導變革的領導力。
intent.en: Tests adaptability under extreme uncertainty, emotional stability, and change leadership.

safe_landing_script.zh: 面對劇變，最重要的是『專注於自己能控制的事』。請容許我用幾秒鐘整理我應對變革的框架...
safe_landing_script.en: In times of upheaval, the key is focusing on what you can control. Allow me a few seconds to structure my change management framework...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「我不需要你理解所有的戰略細節，但我需要你保持積極，不參與辦公室八卦。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "I don't need you to understand all strategic details, but I need you to stay positive and avoid office gossip."

focus.zh: 保持專注與擁抱變化

script.zh: 面對重組，我會保持開放與積極的態度，專注於手頭上的工作不受影響。同時，我會主動向新主管請教部門的新目標，確保自己的日常產出能迅速對齊公司的新戰略。
script.en: Facing restructuring, I maintain an open and positive attitude, focusing on keeping my daily work unaffected. Concurrently, I proactively ask my new manager about the department's new goals to ensure my output quickly aligns with the new strategy.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「你必須成為團隊中的穩定器，幫助主管安撫基層情緒並維持生產力。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "You must be the stabilizer in the team, helping management soothe morale and maintain productivity."

focus.zh: 穩定軍心與重新對齊 KPI

script.zh: 我會發揮中層的承上啟下作用。首先控制自己的焦慮，並在小組內過濾掉無根據的負面猜測。接著，我會迅速梳理現有專案，向主管提出哪些項目應該叫停，哪些應該加速，主動幫助團隊將 KPI 與新戰略重新對齊。
script.en: I play a bridging role. I first manage my own anxiety and filter out baseless negative rumors within my group. Then, I quickly audit ongoing projects, proposing to management which should be paused and which accelerated, proactively realigning the team's KPIs with the new strategy.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「混亂是階梯。我期待你能從危機中看出商機，並帶領整個部門穿越迷霧。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Chaos is a ladder. I expect you to see the opportunity in the crisis and lead the department through the fog."

focus.zh: 傳遞願景 (The 'Why') 與尋找新機遇

script.zh: 組織劇變往往伴隨信任危機。我會第一時間站出來，以最高透明度向團隊溝通變革背後的『Why（為什麼要變）』，以同理心接納他們的不安。同時，我會帶領核心團隊在新的戰略版圖中尋找未被開發的商業機會，將被動的重組轉化為團隊升級的契機。
script.en: Organizational upheaval breeds trust crises. I will immediately step up and communicate the 'Why' behind the change with maximum transparency, empathetically acknowledging their concerns. Simultaneously, I will lead the core team to identify untapped business opportunities in the new strategic landscape, turning passive restructuring into a catalyst for team evolution.

title.zh: 請分享一次你必須與完全不合作、或態度非常負面的同事共事的經歷。
title.en: Tell me about a time you had to work with someone who was completely uncooperative or had a negative attitude.

intent.zh: 考驗人際衝突解決能力、情緒智商，以及是否能在惡劣環境中推進專案。
intent.en: Tests interpersonal conflict resolution, EQ, and the ability to drive projects in toxic environments.

safe_landing_script.zh: 面對負面同事，重點是『處理事情，而不是處理他的情緒』。請給我十秒鐘梳理我的溝通策略...
safe_landing_script.en: When dealing with negative colleagues, the focus is on 'managing the task, not their emotions'. Give me 10 seconds to structure my communication strategy...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「我希望你具備專業素養，不要被對方的情緒拖下水，懂得留下溝通紀錄（Paper Trail）。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "I hope you remain professional, don't get dragged into their toxicity, and know how to keep a paper trail."

focus.zh: 保持專業與留下紀錄

script.zh: 我會保持絕對的專業，不把對方的態度視為針對個人。溝通時我會專注於客觀的任務需求，並在每次口頭討論後，發送一封電郵總結（Meeting Minutes）作為紀錄。若進度確實受阻，我會帶著客觀紀錄尋求主管協助。
script.en: I maintain absolute professionalism, not taking their attitude personally. I focus solely on objective task requirements during communications, and after every verbal discussion, I send a summary email (Meeting Minutes) as a paper trail. If progress is genuinely blocked, I seek my manager's help using objective records.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「負面態度通常有潛在原因。你能否運用同理心找出他的痛點，並建立工作聯盟？」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Negativity usually has an underlying cause. Can you use empathy to find their pain point and build a working alliance?"

focus.zh: 挖掘底層動機與建立信任

script.zh: 我會私下約對方喝咖啡，不談公事，先試著了解他的壓力來源。很多時候，不合作是因為他覺得自己的工作負擔太重或未被看見。當我找出他的痛點後，我會在專案設計上盡量減輕他的麻煩，甚至讓他獲得部分功勞，將阻力轉化為助力。
script.en: I'll invite them for a private coffee to understand their stressors outside of work. Often, uncooperative behavior stems from feeling overworked or unseen. Once I identify their pain point, I adjust the project design to minimize their friction and even share credit with them, turning resistance into assistance.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「若這顆毒蘋果正在破壞團隊文化，作為主管你必須有勇氣進行『困難對話』，甚至請他離開。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "If a bad apple is destroying team culture, as a leader, you must have the courage to have a 'difficult conversation' or manage them out."

focus.zh: 保護團隊文化與果斷處置

script.zh: 作為管理者，保護團隊的心理安全感是首要任務。我會與該員工進行嚴肅的一對一反饋，明確指出其行為對團隊士氣的破壞，並給予限期改善的具體目標。若輔導無效且其價值觀與公司背道而馳，我會果斷啟動 PIP（績效改善計畫）甚至予以解僱，絕不妥協於有毒文化。
script.en: As a manager, protecting psychological safety is paramount. I will have a serious 1-on-1 feedback session, clearly stating how their behavior damages morale, and set specific deadlines for improvement. If coaching fails and their values oppose the company's, I will decisively initiate a PIP or manage them out, never compromising with toxic culture.

title.zh: 你為什麼想加入我們公司？與其他候選人相比，你能帶來什麼獨特價值？
title.en: Why do you want to join our company, and what unique value can you bring compared to other candidates?

intent.zh: 這是一道經典的『Closing Question』，考驗候選人對公司的研究深度、自我定位以及熱情。
intent.en: A classic 'Closing Question' testing the candidate's depth of company research, self-positioning, and enthusiasm.

safe_landing_script.zh: 回答這題的核心公式是『貴公司的痛點/願景 + 我的獨特過往經驗 = 完美契合』。請容許我整理一下思緒...
safe_landing_script.en: The core formula here is 'Your Pain Point/Vision + My Unique Experience = Perfect Fit'. Allow me to organize my thoughts...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「我不在乎你的過往經歷有多驚人，我要看到你對我們產品的熱愛以及極強的學習渴望。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "I don't care how amazing your past is; I want to see a passion for our product and a fierce hunger to learn."

focus.zh: 展現熱忱與文化契合度

script.zh: 我一直是貴公司產品的忠實用戶，非常認同你們『以用戶為中心』的文化。相比其他候選人，我的獨特價值在於極強的執行力與『白紙般』的學習渴望。我已經提前自學了相關技術，準備好第一天就能全力投入工作。
script.en: I've always been a loyal user of your product and deeply resonate with your user-centric culture. Compared to others, my unique value lies in my relentless execution and a hunger to learn like a blank slate. I've already self-studied the relevant tech stack and am ready to dive in on day one.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「別背誦公司官網。告訴我你觀察到了我們面臨的具體挑戰，並證明你能解決它。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Don't recite the website. Tell me you've observed our specific challenges and prove you can solve them."

focus.zh: 對齊痛點與即戰力
focus.en: Aligning with Pain Points & Plug-and-Play Capability

script.zh: 我注意到貴公司近期正準備拓展東南亞市場，這正是我過去三年的專長領域。我的獨特價值在於『即戰力』——我不僅帶來了成功的本地化行銷經驗，更有一套已被驗證的防坑指南。我能幫助團隊少走彎路，加速市場滲透。
script.en: I noticed the company is currently expanding into the SEA market, which perfectly aligns with my expertise over the past three years. My unique value is being 'plug-and-play'—I bring not only successful localized marketing experience but a proven playbook of pitfalls to avoid, helping the team accelerate market penetration.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「我期待你不是來找一份工作，而是來找一個能共同推動產業變革的戰略平台。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "I expect you aren't here for a job, but for a strategic platform to co-drive industry disruption."

focus.zh: 戰略願景與行業影響力

script.zh: 吸引我的不僅是貴公司目前的市佔率，而是你們正在重塑產業標準的決心。我的獨特價值不僅限於我的管理能力，更在於我背後深耕十年的『行業人脈與戰略眼光』。我能為公司引入關鍵的戰略合作夥伴，並從更高的維度，協助董事會制定未來三年的破局戰略。
script.en: What attracts me is not just your current market share, but your ambition to redefine industry standards. My unique value extends beyond management skills; it's the decade of 'industry network and strategic foresight' I bring. I can introduce critical strategic partners and help the board craft a breakthrough strategy for the next three years from a higher dimension.

title.zh: 當你意識到自己或團隊正處於職業倦怠（Burnout）的邊緣，你會如何處理？
title.en: How do you handle a situation where you or your team are on the verge of burnout?

intent.zh: 考驗自我覺察力、邊界設定（Boundary Setting）以及可持續的績效管理能力。
intent.en: Tests self-awareness, boundary setting, and sustainable performance management.

safe_landing_script.zh: 承認疲憊並非軟弱，而是專業風險控管。請給我十秒鐘梳理我應對倦怠的策略...
safe_landing_script.en: Acknowledging exhaustion isn't weakness; it's professional risk management. Give me 10 seconds to outline my burnout strategy...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「我希望你懂得主動溝通，而不是默默承受直到徹底崩潰辭職。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "I want you to communicate proactively, not suffer in silence until you unexpectedly quit."

focus.zh: 自我覺察與主動求助

script.zh: 我會監測自己的效率與情緒指標。當發現出現倦怠跡象時，我會主動與主管進行一對一溝通，客觀展示我目前的工作負載，並請教如何重新調整任務的優先順序，確保能在健康的前提下維持產出品質。
script.en: I monitor my own efficiency and mood. When I notice signs of burnout, I proactively schedule a 1-on-1 with my manager to objectively review my workload and seek guidance on reprioritizing tasks, ensuring I can maintain quality output healthily.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「作為中堅力量，你需要具備資源重組的能力，保護你的團隊免受不合理的壓榨。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "As a core pillar, you must be able to restructure resources to protect your team from unreasonable squeeze."

focus.zh: 工作量重分配與心理安全

script.zh: 倦怠通常是因為『資源與期望不匹配』。我會先暫停非緊急專案，與團隊進行坦誠對話，了解他們的壓力源。接著，我會帶著數據向上管理，爭取延長死線或增加資源，並在團隊內部強制執行『斷網休息』政策，重建心理安全感。
script.en: Burnout usually stems from a mismatch between resources and expectations. I would pause non-urgent projects and have a candid dialogue with the team to identify stressors. Then, I manage up with data to negotiate extended deadlines or additional resources, while enforcing a 'disconnect to recharge' policy internally.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「高階主管必須從制度面解決問題：是我們的文化太有毒，還是流程太低效？」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Senior leaders must solve this systemically: Is our culture toxic, or are our processes inefficient?"

focus.zh: 系統性改革與文化重塑

script.zh: 團隊大面積倦怠是管理體系的失職。我會從根本上檢視部門的 KPI 設計與流程效率，消除無意義的會議與重複勞動。更重要的是，我會以身作則展現『健康邊界』，將員工福祉與人才留任率納入管理層的考核指標，從文化層面徹底解決問題。
script.en: Widespread team burnout is a failure of the management system. I will systemically audit our KPI designs and process efficiencies to eliminate pointless meetings and redundant work. More importantly, I will role-model 'healthy boundaries' and integrate employee wellbeing and retention rates into management metrics to fix the culture at its root.

title.zh: 如果你偶然發現上司或公司的某個決策存在嚴重的道德或合規（Compliance）瑕疵，你會怎麼做？
title.en: What would you do if you discovered a severe ethical or compliance flaw in a decision made by your manager or the company?

intent.zh: 這是一道壓力測試題，考驗道德勇氣、風險意識以及處理敏感問題的政治智慧。
intent.en: A stress-test question evaluating moral courage, risk awareness, and political tact in handling sensitive issues.

safe_landing_script.zh: 處理合規問題必須『基於事實，而非假設』。請給我幾秒鐘，我會分享如何謹慎且合規地處理...
safe_landing_script.en: Handling compliance issues must be 'based on facts, not assumptions'. Give me a few seconds to explain how I handle this carefully...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「我需要知道你不會盲目包庇，但也不會未經查證就四處散播謠言。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "I need to know you won't blindly cover it up, nor spread rumors without verification."

focus.zh: 事實查核與尋求指引

script.zh: 我不會急於下定論，而是先仔細查核公司政策與事實證據。如果疑慮依然存在，我會私下、客觀地向上司請教該決策的背景（假設他可能疏忽了）。若確認違規且上司拒絕修正，我會根據公司的吹哨人（Whistleblower）政策向 HR 或法務部尋求指引。
script.en: I won't jump to conclusions, but first carefully verify facts against company policies. If concerns persist, I will privately and objectively ask my manager for context (assuming oversight). If compliance is breached and they refuse to amend it, I will follow the company's whistleblower policy and consult HR or Legal.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「你需要有能力將『道德譴責』轉化為『商業風險提示』，說服決策者懸崖勒馬。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "You must translate 'moral condemnation' into 'business risk warnings' to persuade decision-makers to pivot."

focus.zh: 風險量化與提供合規方案

script.zh: 我會將道德問題轉化為商業風險。我會整理一份備忘錄，列出該決策可能引發的法律訴訟、罰款及品牌公關災難，並私下向決策者匯報。同時，我會準備一個『達成相同商業目的，但完全合規』的替代方案，給予對方台階下與修正的機會。
script.en: I translate ethical issues into business risks. I would draft a memo outlining potential legal liabilities, fines, and brand PR disasters, presenting it privately to the decision-maker. Crucially, I will provide a fully compliant alternative that achieves the same business goal, offering them a graceful way to pivot.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「高管的職責是保護公司的長期聲譽，即便這意味著要挑戰更高的權威。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "An executive's duty is to protect the company's long-term reputation, even if it means challenging higher authorities."

focus.zh: 守護公司底線與建立治理機制
focus.en: Safeguarding the Bottom Line & Corporate Governance

script.zh: 誠信是不可談判的底線。若發現重大瑕疵，我會立即要求中止相關行動，並會同法務總監進行內部審計。若牽涉高層舞弊，我會毫不猶豫地越級向董事會或審計委員會報告。事後，我會推動完善內部控制與合規培訓，確保這類系統性漏洞被徹底封死。
script.en: Integrity is non-negotiable. I would immediately halt the action and initiate an internal audit with the Legal Director. If it involves executive misconduct, I will not hesitate to escalate to the Board of Directors or Audit Committee. Afterwards, I will drive the enhancement of internal controls and compliance training to permanently close such systemic loopholes.

title.zh: 你曾否向你的上司提出過建設性的『負面反饋』？當時的具體情況與結果是什麼？
title.en: Have you ever given constructive negative feedback to your manager? What was the situation and outcome?

intent.zh: 考驗膽識、溝通技巧 (Tact)，以及如何在不損害權威的情況下推動進步。
intent.en: Tests tact, courage, and constructive communication without undermining authority.

safe_landing_script.zh: 向上反饋的核心是『出於共同利益』。請容許我分享一次我如何用數據幫助主管避開盲點的經歷...
safe_landing_script.en: The core of upward feedback is 'acting out of mutual interest'. Allow me to share a time I used data to help my manager avoid a blind spot...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「不要用指責的語氣，試著用『我訊息 (I-statement)』表達主管的行為如何影響你的工作效率。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Avoid an accusatory tone. Use 'I-statements' to express how their behavior impacts your efficiency."

focus.zh: 表達影響與尋求協作

script.zh: 有次主管經常在下班前臨時派發急件，導致出錯率增加。我私下約他討論，沒有指責，而是說：『為了確保我能維持高質量的產出，想請教我們能否在每天下午兩點前對齊當日的急件？』主管意識到了這個問題，隨後我們優化了派單流程。
script.en: My manager frequently assigned urgent tasks right before closing, increasing error rates. I spoke with him privately, avoiding blame, and said: 'To ensure I maintain high-quality output, could we align on urgent tasks by 2 PM daily?' He realized the issue, and we subsequently optimized the workflow.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「我期待你能指出我的管理盲點，並直接提供解決方案讓我選擇。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "I expect you to point out my managerial blind spots and provide direct solutions for me to choose from."

focus.zh: 聚焦專案目標與提供方案
focus.en: Focusing on Project Goals & Providing Solutions

script.zh: 主管曾微觀管理（Micromanage）一個專案，拖慢了進度。我與他進行了一對一溝通，將焦點放在『專案目標』上：『我注意到目前的審批流程影響了交付速度。為減輕您的負擔，我建議將次要決策授權給我，我每週五給您一頁紙的總結報告。』這成功爭取了信任與空間。
script.en: My manager was micromanaging a project, slowing progress. I had a 1-on-1, focusing on the 'project goals': 'I noticed our approval process is impacting delivery speed. To lighten your load, I suggest delegating secondary decisions to me, and I will provide a one-pager summary every Friday.' This successfully won me trust and space.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「作為高管的副手或平級，你必須有能力挑戰我的戰略決策，防止公司走偏。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "As an executive peer or deputy, you must be able to challenge my strategic decisions to keep the company on track."

focus.zh: 戰略盲點對齊與高管互信

script.zh: 高層有次堅持推動一項未經驗證的產品線。我基於市場數據與 ROI 模型，在私下會議中坦白表達了我的反對意見：『這個決策可能嚴重稀釋我們的核心資源。』雖然過程有激烈辯論，但我成功說服他先做小規模試點，最終避免了巨大的沉沒成本，這也加深了我們之間的戰略互信。
script.en: Our executive once insisted on pushing an unvalidated product line. Based on market data and ROI models, I candidly voiced my opposition in a private meeting: 'This decision risks severely diluting our core resources.' Despite a vigorous debate, I persuaded them to run a pilot first, preventing a massive sunk cost and deepening our strategic mutual trust.

title.zh: 團隊中的一位明星員工（Star Employee）突然績效下滑、失去動力。你會如何介入？
title.en: A star employee in your team suddenly experiences a drop in performance and loses motivation. How do you intervene?

intent.zh: 考驗教練技巧（Coaching）、同理心，以及分辨內在動機與外在壓力的能力。
intent.en: Tests coaching skills, empathy, and the ability to distinguish between intrinsic motivation and extrinsic stress.

safe_landing_script.zh: 績效下滑通常是『結果』，而非『原因』。請給我十秒鐘分享我的診斷與輔導步驟...
safe_landing_script.en: A performance drop is a symptom, not the root cause. Give me 10 seconds to share my diagnostic and coaching steps...

hiring_manager_os.zh: （針對同儕協作）「雖然你不是主管，但我想看看你是否具備團隊互助的敏銳度。」
hiring_manager_os.en: (Targeting Peer Support) "Although not a manager, I want to see if you have the acumen for team mutual support."

focus.zh: 同儕支持與傾聽

script.zh: 作為同事，我會敏銳地察覺他的變化，並主動約他吃個便飯。我不會刺探隱私，而是表達關心，讓他知道如果需要分擔工作或傾訴，我隨時都在。有時候，一個充滿同理心的傾聽者就能幫助同儕走出低潮。
script.en: As a peer, I'd notice the change and invite them for a casual lunch. I won't pry, but simply express care and let them know I'm available to help share the load or just listen. Sometimes, an empathetic ear is enough to help a colleague navigate a slump.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「你需要找出病因。是因為遇到天花板、家庭變故，還是覺得未被賞識？」
hiring_manager_os.en: "You need to find the root cause. Have they hit a ceiling, faced personal issues, or felt underappreciated?"

focus.zh: 深度訪談與重新對齊目標

script.zh: 我會安排一次深度的 1-on-1。首先肯定他過去的卓越貢獻，然後坦誠表達我的觀察。我會引導他說出真實原因：如果是遇到職業瓶頸，我會為他設計新的挑戰（Job Crafting）；如果是私人壓力，我會主動提供彈性工時，給予他喘息與恢復的空間。
script.en: I'd schedule a deep 1-on-1. I'll start by affirming their past stellar contributions, then candidly share my observations. I guide them to reveal the root cause: if it's a career bottleneck, I utilize 'Job Crafting' to design new challenges; if it's personal stress, I offer flexible hours to give them space to recover.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「明星員工的流失是巨大的商業損失。你要檢視公司的薪酬、升遷與文化結構是否出了問題。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Losing a star employee is a massive business loss. You must examine if the company's comp, promo, or culture structures are failing."

focus.zh: 人才盤點與結構性留才

script.zh: 除了個人輔導，我會將此視為『結構性流失風險』的預警。我會檢視公司的激勵機制是否失效，或者部門是否過度依賴少數英雄（Key-man Risk）。為留住頂尖人才，我會為他量身打造接班人計畫與領導力軌道；同時優化整體薪酬結構，確保卓越付出能獲得相對應的戰略回報。
script.en: Beyond personal coaching, I treat this as a warning of 'structural retention risk'. I evaluate if our incentive mechanisms are failing or if we have excessive Key-man Risk. To retain top talent, I would tailor a leadership track and succession plan for them, while optimizing the overall compensation structure to ensure stellar efforts yield strategic returns.

title.zh: 請分享一次你與背景、工作文化完全不同的人合作的經驗。遇到摩擦時你如何解決？
title.en: Share an experience working with someone from a completely different background or work culture. How did you resolve friction?

intent.zh: 考驗多元共融意識（DEI）、適應力以及跨部門/跨國協作時的溝通彈性。
intent.en: Tests Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI) awareness, adaptability, and communication flexibility in cross-functional/global collaboration.

safe_landing_script.zh: 跨文化溝通的核心是『好奇心大於評判（Curiosity over Judgment）』。請給我幾秒鐘梳理我的溝通策略...
safe_landing_script.en: The core of cross-cultural communication is 'Curiosity over Judgment'. Give me a few seconds to organize my communication strategy...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「我希望看到你具備包容心，不會因為對方做事方式不同就產生排斥。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "I want to see inclusivity. You shouldn't reject someone just because their working style differs."

focus.zh: 尊重差異與釐清溝通方式

script.zh: 我曾與海外團隊合作，他們習慣直言不諱的批評，這起初讓我感到不適。但我意識到這是文化差異而非針對個人。我主動與他們探討雙方的溝通風格，並約定在回饋時先說明背景，這極大減少了誤解，合作也變得順暢。
script.en: I worked with an overseas team accustomed to blunt criticism, which initially felt jarring. I realized it was a cultural difference, not personal. I proactively discussed our communication styles with them and agreed to provide context before feedback, drastically reducing misunderstandings and smoothing collaboration.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「你需要成為橋樑，將不同背景的人凝聚在一起，建立屬於你們團隊的共同語言。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "You need to be the bridge, uniting people from diverse backgrounds and establishing a shared team language."

focus.zh: 建立共識與團隊規範

script.zh: 跨國或跨界合作經常因預設期望不同而產生摩擦。我不會強迫對方接受我的方式，而是發起一個『團隊章程（Team Charter）』會議。我們共同定義了響應時間、會議規則與決策流程，用『新規則』取代了各自的『舊習慣』，建立了高效的協作共識。
script.en: Cross-cultural or cross-domain collaborations often clash due to differing default expectations. Instead of forcing my way, I initiated a 'Team Charter' meeting. We co-defined response times, meeting rules, and decision processes. Replacing our 'old habits' with 'new rules' established a highly efficient collaborative consensus.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「真正的多元共融不是消除差異，而是利用差異來激發創新（Leverage Diversity for Innovation）。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "True DEI isn't about erasing differences, but leveraging diversity for innovation."

focus.zh: 利用多元化優勢推動創新

script.zh: 我曾帶領一個極度多元的跨國團隊。摩擦必然存在，但我將這種衝突視為創新的催化劑。當設計與工程團隊因文化與專業思維發生激烈爭執時，我沒有壓制反對聲音，而是引導雙方從完全不同的視角審視產品。最終，這種多元碰撞讓我們發現了一個未被開發的在地化市場需求，這正是 DEI 帶來的真實商業價值。
script.en: I led a highly diverse, multi-national team. Friction is inevitable, but I treat it as a catalyst for innovation. When design and engineering clashed fiercely due to cultural and professional mindsets, I didn't suppress the dissent. I guided them to examine the product from completely opposing angles. Ultimately, this diverse collision helped us uncover an untapped localized market need—this is the true business value of DEI.
